usage:
  rosa init [Name]        scaffold a project here; Name is the root
                          namespace (default: PascalCased dir name)
  rosa lib <name> [--fs]  seed a lib subproject wired to the machinery;
                          namespace = GameNs.LibName
  rosa sync [version]     rewrite the rosa-owned files and stamp
                          RosaVersion (default: latest from the feed)
  rosa local [on|off] [path]
                          build against a local rosa checkout instead
                          of the feed (default path: ../rosa); also
